title: Barrett esophagus
description: Diagnosis, the four lines of surface maturation, and dysplasia grading.

beats.say: Barrett esophagus: how to make the diagnosis, and how to grade dysplasia.
At endoscopy, at least one centimeter of columnar mucosa above the gastroesophageal junction.
beats.detail: At least 1 cm of columnar mucosa above the GE junction

beats.say: On histology, intestinal metaplasia with goblet cells.
You need both, so a biopsy alone cannot make the diagnosis.
beats.text: You need both. A biopsy alone cannot make the diagnosis.

scenes.heading: Four lines

image.alt: Barrett mucosa with the four surface lines

scenes.credit: Figure: Voltaggio L, Montgomery EA. Surg Pathol Clin 2017;10:781
beats: To judge the surface, look for four lines.

beats.say: Line one is the mucin droplet.
Line two is the base of the mucin vacuole.
Line three is the cytoplasm below it.
And line four is the row of nuclei.
When the four lines run parallel, the surface is maturing and nondysplastic.
When they are lost, look closely for dysplasia.

image.alt: Barrett mucosa: maturing surface on the left, dysplastic surface on the right

beats.say: On the left, the surface matures, with mucin at the top.
beats.text: Left: the surface matures, mucin on top

beats.say: On the right, crowded, dark nuclei run all the way up to the surface.
beats.text: Right: crowded nuclei reach the surface

beats.say: No maturation at the surface means dysplasia, here high grade.

scenes.heading: The dysplasia ladder
beats: Then grade it on a ladder.

beats.say: Negative: the atypia matures toward the surface.
Indefinite: you can't call it, usually because of inflammation, erosion, or a technical problem.
beats.detail: Can't call it: inflammation, erosion, technical

beats.say: Low grade: the atypia reaches the surface, but polarity is kept.
beats.detail: Atypia reaches the surface, polarity kept

beats.say: High grade: marked atypia, lost polarity, and complex glands.
beats.detail: Marked atypia, polarity lost, complex glands

beats.say: And intramucosal carcinoma invades the lamina propria or muscularis mucosae.
beats.detail: Into the lamina propria or muscularis mucosae

scenes.heading: What the grade means for the patient

beats.say: Nondysplastic Barrett is followed with surveillance every three to five years.
Low grade dysplasia should be confirmed by an expert GI pathologist, and is then usually ablated.
beats.detail: Confirm with an expert GI pathologist, then usually ablation

beats.say: High grade dysplasia or T1a carcinoma gets endoscopic eradication.
The take-home: a maturing surface is negative.
Atypia that reaches the surface is dysplasia.
beats.text: Atypia that reaches the surface is dysplasia
